notes_for_editor: Only two sources. Dunigan's list gives name, county, elevation and a datasheet reference, but no build date, operator, height or status. TopoQuest only confirms the Sappville community at about the same coordinates (about 105 m apart by our calculation; the story says about 100 m and labels it as our calculation). Elevation units are not stated on the list; 154 is read as feet, which matches TopoQuest's 150 ft. A Georgia Archives search snippet names a cell tower 'Sappville (W361)' north of Highway 82 in Ware County; that archive page returned 403 and was not read, so it may or may not be this site. Status unknown; a field check or a Georgia Forestry Commission tower list would be needed before writing more.
